name: hgi_qdq_tsplit_ctl_r4
slot_change_request: quant_NW_xp_ctl: master ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r3 -> ot_hgi_qdq_transport_ctl_r4 (rl_cfg 6 -> 7 bits, RLI 2..126 / WCI 2..63; ties RLI = RL+4+2*XR, WCI = WC+2+XR from the soft parent ot_hgi_qdq_host_split_r3); same 108 um outline -> HBM-DIE12 (NOTICE).

job.purpose: Deep strap QUANT transport controller for the d4g split r3: GEN2e4 r11 needs RL 54 at hb_quant_NW (RLI 58+2XR), ctl_r3 takes RLI <= 46. Command metadata ring in one 128x64 1R1W SRAM. Bench = split r3 lockstep vs the monolith at L 7 / 54, XR 0 / 12.

benches.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_ring_late
benches.why: ctl_r4 ring read address one entry late (MUT 3): rsel / dst / header one command off

benches.name: QDQ_SPLIT_R3_mutant_unpriced_relay
benches.why: L 54, 12 relay stages present, straps priced for 11

structural_change: ctl r4: ctl_r3 (strap latency, pin capture registers, reset relay, closed TT +127.80 / FF +14.92) with the 46-bit command metadata pipeline sp/dp/hp moved from a 48-deep flop shift register into a 128-entry ring in one ot_sram_1r1w_128x64_m1_p192 (write every edge at wp, read at wp+1-RLI; rd = tap NP-3, two flop stages = tap NP-1); vp/lp stay reset flops. RLI 2..126 covers the GEN2e4 die need RL 54 (RLI 58 + 2*XR); flop pipeline at NP 128 would be ~5.9 kb (> 2 kb storage rule).

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin already (ctl_r4 captures (as ctl_r3) every cmd_* and strap bit at its pin, rr_v/vo/qfault/decode_fault enter flops, every output is a register, rst_n drives only the 3-flop relay): ctl_r2 with the same boundary is native PASS (launch 181.2, capture 138.1, 0 comb). Extra tool pin registers would add edges the split r2 lockstep does not price.
